title: Richard Nixon: Resigned
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来“美国总统”系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about Richard Nixon.
sentences.zh: 今天我们聊一聊理查德·尼克松。

sentences.en: Nixon is well-known to many Americans for one reason: he was the only president to resign from the position.
sentences.zh: 尼克松之所以为许多美国人所熟知，原因只有一个：他是唯一一位辞去总统职务的总统。

sentences.en: Facing possible legal action by Congress, Nixon left office early in his second term.
sentences.zh: 面对国会可能发起的法律行动，尼克松在第二任期初期便离开了白宫。

sentences.en: Nixon’s early political career was marked by success.
sentences.zh: 尼克松早期的政治生涯以成功为标志。

sentences.en: He also had some noteworthy achievements during his White House years.
sentences.zh: 他在白宫任职期间也取得了一些值得一提的成就。

sentences.en: And he attained his goal of moving the government in a more conservative direction.
sentences.zh: 他还实现了将政府推向更保守方向的这一目标。

sentences.en: In his later years, Nixon and his supporters tried to reclaim his place as an expert on international affairs.
sentences.zh: 在晚年，尼克松和他的支持者试图重新夺回他作为国际事务专家的地位。

sentences.en: But for many Americans, the name “Nixon” remains linked to distrust of national leaders, abuse of power, and political wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 但对许多美国人来说，“尼克松”这个名字依然与对国家领导者的不信任、滥用权力和政治不当行为联系在一起。

sentences.en: Richard Nixon had a difficult early life.
sentences.zh: 理查德·尼克松的早年生活十分艰难。

sentences.en: He was the second of five sons in a Quaker family.
sentences.zh: 他是贵格会家庭中五个儿子里的第二个。

sentences.en: His parents owned a lemon ranch in California, near the city of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他的父母在洛杉矶附近拥有一座柠檬种植园。

sentences.en: But the family struggled financially.
sentences.zh: 但家庭经济状况一直十分拮据。

sentences.en: And two of Richard’s brothers died – one as a small child, and one as a young adult.
sentences.zh: 理查德的两个兄弟相继离世——一个在幼年夭折，一个在成年早期去世。

sentences.en: In time, his parent’s business failed, and the Nixons moved to a nearby town.
sentences.zh: 久而久之，父母的生意破产，尼克松一家搬到了附近的一个城镇。

sentences.en: The parents and children all worked at a filling station that sold fuel and other products.
sentences.zh: 父母和孩子们都在一家售卖燃油及其他产品的加油站工作。

sentences.en: Despite the many hours he worked at the store, Richard Nixon was a top student in high school.
sentences.zh: 尽管在店里工作了大量时间，理查德·尼克松依然是高中里的尖子生。

sentences.en: He was offered financial aid to attend Harvard University, but the family needed even more money to send him there.
sentences.zh: 他获得了哈佛大学的经济援助以入校就读，但家里需要更多的钱才能送他去那里。

sentences.en: Instead, he attended a local college, where he became the student body president, joined a debate team, acted in the theater, and played football.
sentences.zh: 于是，他就读了当地的一所大学，在那里他当选为学生会主席，加入了辩论队，参与戏剧演出，还踢了足球。

sentences.en: Nixon went on to law school at Duke University in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 此后，尼克松进入北卡罗来纳州的杜克大学法学院深造。

sentences.en: Even with his impressive background, he did not get the jobs he sought at the Federal Bureau of Investigation – the FBI – or top law offices.
sentences.zh: 尽管背景令人印象深刻，他并未获得联邦调查局——FBI——或顶级律所想要招聘的职位。

sentences.en: So he returned the California town where he grew up and began working as a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 于是他回到自己长大的加利福尼亚小镇，开始从事律师工作。

sentences.en: There, he married another actor at the community theater.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他与社区剧院的另一位演员结了婚。

sentences.en: Her name was Thelma Ryan, but she was called Pat.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫塞尔玛·瑞安，但大家都叫她帕特。

sentences.en: The Nixons went on to have two daughters, Tricia and Julie.
sentences.zh: 尼克松夫妇又育有两个女儿，分别是特里西娅和朱莉。

sentences.en: In 1942, Nixon accepted a job with the federal government in Washington, DC.
sentences.zh: 1942年，尼克松接受了在华盛顿特区联邦政府的一项工作。

sentences.en: He did not stay in the position long.
sentences.zh: 他没有在这个职位上待太久。

sentences.en: After the United States entered World War II, Nixon joined the Navy.
sentences.zh: 美国加入第二次世界大战后，尼克松加入了海军。

sentences.en: He served as an officer in the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 他在太平洋地区担任军官职务。

sentences.en: When he returned to the U.S., Republican Party officials asked him to be a candidate for Congress. Nixon agreed.
sentences.zh: 当他回到美国后，共和党官员请他作为国会候选人参选，尼克松同意了。

sentences.en: He won two terms in the House of Representatives, and then a seat in the U.S. Senate.
sentences.zh: 他在众议院连任两届，随后又获得了美国参议院的一个席位。

sentences.en: Two years later, Dwight Eisenhower, the Republican presidential candidate, asked Nixon to be his vice president.
sentences.zh: 两年后，共和党总统候选人德怀特·艾森豪威尔请尼克松担任他的副总统。

sentences.en: The two men won in an electoral landslide, and in 1953 Nixon took office as vice president.
sentences.zh: 两人以压倒性优势赢得选举，并于1953年尼克松就任副总统。

sentences.en: He was only 40 years old, the second-youngest vice president in U.S. history.
sentences.zh: 当时他年仅40岁，是美国历史上第二年轻的副总统。

sentences.en: Nixon’s early political career is remembered for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 尼克松早期的政治生涯因几个原因而被人们铭记。

sentences.en: One is how quickly he rose to high government office.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是他升任高级政府职位的速度之快。

sentences.en: Another is for his part in the Alger Hiss case in the late 1940s.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是在20世纪40年代末他在阿尔杰·赫斯案中所扮演的角色。

sentences.en: Hiss was a top official in the State Department.
sentences.zh: 赫斯是国务院的高级官员。

sentences.en: He was accused of being a Communist in the 1930s and 1940s, and of passing information about the U.S. government to Soviet spies.
sentences.zh: 他被指控在20世纪30年代和40年代是共产党员，并向苏联间谍传递有关美国政府的信息。

sentences.en: Hiss denied the accusations.
sentences.zh: 赫斯否认了这些指控。

sentences.en: The case was big news in the United States.
sentences.zh: 此案在美国曾是大新闻。

sentences.en: It showed the clash between people who believed Hiss was falsely accused as a way to discredit liberal policies, and people who believed the government was protecting communist sympathizers.
sentences.zh: 它展现了两种人之间的冲突：一种人相信希斯是被冤枉的，这是为了诋毁自由派政策的手段；另一种人相信政府在保护具有同情共产主义倾向的人。

sentences.en: Nixon was in the second group.
sentences.zh: 尼克松属于第二群人。

sentences.en: He was part of the investigation against Hiss and pushed for his indictment.
sentences.zh: 他是针对希斯的调查小组成员之一，并力主对他提起指控。

sentences.en: Nixon’s efforts succeeded, and Hiss went to jail for almost four years.
sentences.zh: 尼克松的努力取得了成功，希斯因此入狱近四年。

sentences.en: Later, Nixon said that the case was one of the reasons for his rise to power.
sentences.zh: 后来，尼克松说，此案是他崛起掌权的众多原因之一。

sentences.en: Nixon also earned national attention with an event that has become known as the Checkers speech.
sentences.zh: 尼克松还因一桩后来被称为"鸡蛋演讲"的事件而获得全国关注。

sentences.en: It happened in 1952, when Nixon was running for vice president.
sentences.zh: 这件事发生在1952年，当时尼克松正在竞选副总统。

sentences.en: Some reporters accused Nixon of corruption.
sentences.zh: 一些记者指控尼克松腐败。

sentences.en: They said he was accepting money and gifts from wealthy donors in exchange for his political support.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他接受富有的捐助者的金钱和礼物，以换取自己的政治支持。

sentences.en: Nixon went on television to deny the claims personally.
sentences.zh: 尼克松登上电视，亲自否认这些指控。

sentences.en: At the time, Americans were not used to seeing politicians speaking directly to the public.
sentences.zh: 当时，美国人还不习惯看到政治家直接向公众讲话。

sentences.en: Yet Nixon spoke informally and emotionally, from what appeared to be a home.
sentences.zh: 然而，尼克松却以非正式、充满感情的方式发表演讲，看起来仿佛是在家中。

sentences.en: He explained his family’s finances.
sentences.zh: 他解释了自己家庭的财务状况。

sentences.en: He said he did not accept campaign donations for personal benefit.
sentences.zh: 他说，他并没有为了个人利益而接受竞选捐款。

sentences.en: But, he added, there was one exception.
sentences.zh: 但是，他补充道，有一个例外。

sentences.en: A supporter had once given the Nixon children a black and white dog they called Checkers.
sentences.zh: 一位支持者曾经送给尼克松家的孩子们一只黑白相间的狗，他们叫它"鸡蛋"。

sentences.en: Nixon said he refused to return his daughters’ pet.
sentences.zh: 尼克松说他拒绝归还女儿们的宠物。

sentences.en: The public – and Republican Party officials – loved the speech.
sentences.zh: 公众——以及共和党官员——都非常喜爱这场演讲。

sentences.en: Nixon appeared warm and likable.
sentences.zh: 尼克松显得既亲切又讨人喜欢。

sentences.en: Middle-class Americans especially said they could relate to him.
sentences.zh: 美国中产阶级尤其表示能够与他产生共鸣。

sentences.en: Most forgot the claims against him.
sentences.zh: 大多数人忘记了对他的指控。

sentences.en: And Nixon’s political career was saved.
sentences.zh: 而尼克松的政治生涯得以挽救。

sentences.en: During the following eight years, he served as vice president in the Eisenhower administration.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的八年里，他在艾森豪威尔政府中担任副总统。

sentences.en: But then Nixon’s luck turned.
sentences.zh: 但随后尼克松的运气发生了转折。

sentences.en: In 1960, Nixon lost as a presidential candidate to John F. Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 1960年，尼克松作为总统候选人输给了约翰·F·肯尼迪。

sentences.en: He blamed, in part, the media.
sentences.zh: 他部分地将此归咎于媒体。

sentences.en: Then in 1962, he lost his efforts to be governor of California.
sentences.zh: 然后在1962年，他竞选加利福尼亚州州长的努力失败了。

sentences.en: Nixon said he was retiring from politics.
sentences.zh: 尼克松说他即将退出政坛。

sentences.en: He famously told reporters, “You won’t have Nixon to kick around anymore.”
sentences.zh: 他 famously 对记者说：“你们以后不会再有尼克松可以随意欺负了。”

sentences.en: Yet seven years later, he was in the White House.
sentences.zh: 然而七年之后，他进入了白宫。

sentences.en: It was one of the most memorable comebacks in U.S. political history.
sentences.zh: 这是美国政治史上最令人难忘的复出之一。

sentences.en: When Nixon took office in 1969, some Americans thought the country was in crisis.
sentences.zh: 当尼克松于1969年就职时，一些美国人认为国家正处于危机之中。

sentences.en: The economy was not doing well.
sentences.zh: 经济状况不佳。

sentences.en: Race riots had been erupting in big cities.
sentences.zh: 种族骚乱在大城市中不断爆发。

sentences.en: Many people were still trying to recover from the violence of a year earlier.
sentences.zh: 许多人仍在努力从一年前的暴力事件中恢复过来。

sentences.en: Civil rights leader Martin Luther King Junior and President John F.
sentences.zh: 民权领袖马丁·路德·金和总统约翰·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy’s brother Robert had both been shot and killed.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪的弟弟罗伯特都遭到了枪击并身亡。

sentences.en: Pollution of the environment was becoming a major political issue.
sentences.zh: 环境污染正逐渐成为一个重大的政治议题。

sentences.en: Women were pressing for equal rights.
sentences.zh: 妇女们正在争取平等权利。

sentences.en: And many Americans continued to protest American involvement in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 许多美国人继续抗议美国卷入越南战争。

sentences.en: Nixon took action.
sentences.zh: 尼克松采取了行动。

sentences.en: During his first years in office, he supported reforms and rules to improve the economy; protect the environment; increase workplace and other opportunities for women; support civil rights; and, in his words, bring “peace with honor” in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 在他任职的头几年里，他支持改革和规则以改善经济、保护环境、增加妇女在职场及其他方面的机会、支持民权，并用他自己的话说，在越南实现“体面的和平”。

sentences.en: But, for the most part, Nixon did not have the support of Congress to enact legislation.
sentences.zh: 但是，在大多数情况下，尼克松并没有获得国会的支持来通过立法。

sentences.en: So he expanded the power of the presidency to carry out his goals.
sentences.zh: 因此，他扩大了总统的权力以贯彻他的目标。

sentences.en: He is remembered especially for three foreign policy moves.
sentences.zh: 他尤其因三项外交政策举措而被铭记。

sentences.en: In 1972, he visited China, with which the U.S. government had tense relations since the Chinese Communist Party took power.
sentences.zh: 1972年，他访问了中国，而自中国共产党执政以来，美国政府与中国保持着紧张的关系。

sentences.en: As the Alger Hiss case showed, Nixon was strongly anti-communist.
sentences.zh: 正如阿尔杰·希斯案所表明的那样，尼克松是坚定的反共主义者。

sentences.en: But he made establishing diplomatic relations between the two sides possible again.
sentences.zh: 但他使双方建立外交关系成为可能。

sentences.en: He also visited the Soviet Union, and was the first U.S. president to visit Moscow.
sentences.zh: 他还访问了苏联，成为首位访问莫斯科的美国总统。

sentences.en: Nixon and the Soviet leader, Leonid Brezhnev, agreed to limit the growth of nuclear arms.
sentences.zh: 尼克松与苏联领导人列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫同意限制核武器的增长。

sentences.en: Their actions helped ease tensions at a time when U.S. officials were worried about the expansion of communism.
sentences.zh: 他们的行动有助于在官员们担心共产主义扩张的时候缓解紧张局势。

sentences.en: And Nixon did succeed in reaching a peace agreement with North Vietnamese leaders.
sentences.zh: 而且尼克松确实成功与北越南领导人达成了和平协议。

sentences.en: In 1973, American troops slowly began to leave the country, although fighting there continued.
sentences.zh: 1973年，美军开始缓慢撤离该国，尽管当地的战斗仍在继续。

sentences.en: Nixon’s foreign policy achievements helped him in the 1972 election campaign.
sentences.zh: 尼克松的外交政策成就帮助他在1972年的选举中获胜。

sentences.en: His first presidential election had been extremely close; the second he won by one of the widest electoral vote margins in U.S. history.
sentences.zh: 他的首次总统选举极其接近；第二次他以美国历史上最大的选举人票差距之一获胜。

sentences.en: Even though he was popular with voters, Nixon had been concerned about his political future.
sentences.zh: 尽管他深受选民欢迎，尼克松却对自己的政治前途感到担忧。

sentences.en: Nixon was so worried that, before the election, he created a secret team to prevent any damaging information from reaching the media.
sentences.zh: 尼克松如此担忧，以至于在选举之前，他组建了一个秘密小组，以防止任何有害信息流入媒体。

sentences.en: Later, its job expanded to include investigating any information that might hurt his public image.
sentences.zh: 后来，它的工作范围扩大到包括调查任何可能损害其公众形象的信息。

sentences.en: About five months before Election Day, five men broke into the opposition party’s headquarters at the Watergate, a hotel and office complex, in Washington, DC.
sentences.zh: 在选举日大约五个月前，五名男子闯入了华盛顿特区水门一家酒店和办公综合体内的反对党总部。

sentences.en: The team had already stolen copies of secret campaign documents.
sentences.zh: 该团伙早已偷走了秘密竞选文件的副本。

sentences.en: Now, in the middle of the night, the men were trying to add listening equipment to the telephones – in other words, spy on the opposition.
sentences.zh: 如今，深夜时分，这些人正试图在电话里安装窃听设备——换句话说，就是在监视反对派。

sentences.en: But a security guard became suspicious and called the police.
sentences.zh: 但一名保安起了疑心，于是报警。

sentences.en: The men were caught and arrested.
sentences.zh: 这些人被当场抓获并逮捕。

sentences.en: When the story came to light, Nixon publicly denied that any White House officials were involved in the crime.
sentences.zh: 当此事曝光后，尼克松公开否认有任何白宫官员卷入此案。

sentences.en: But in time, the public learned that Nixon was lying.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，公众得知尼克松在撒谎。

sentences.en: In fact, he assisted with payments to the men who were arrested.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他协助向被捕者支付款项。

sentences.en: And he tried to use the Central Intelligence Agency to block an FBI investigation of the crime.
sentences.zh: 他还试图动用中央情报局来阻止联邦调查局对这起案件的调查。

sentences.en: Nixon knew that the Watergate break-in was only part of the illegal or questionable acts he could be held responsible for.
sentences.zh: 尼克松知道，水门事件的非法闯入只是他可能被追究责任的一系列非法或可疑行为中的一环。

sentences.en: Later, people connected with Nixon told investigators that the president had taped everything that happened in his office.
sentences.zh: 后来，与尼克松有关的人告诉调查人员，总统把他办公室里发生的一切都用录音设备记录了下来。

sentences.en: Investigators demanded the tapes.
sentences.zh: 调查人员要求交出这些录音带。

sentences.en: They would prove how much Nixon knew about the illegal operations.
sentences.zh: 这些录音带将证明尼克松对这些非法操作了解多少。

sentences.en: The president refused.
sentences.zh: 总统拒绝了。

sentences.en: He dismissed the lead investigator.
sentences.zh: 他解雇了首席调查员。

sentences.en: Two other Justice Department officials resigned in protest.
sentences.zh: 另外两名司法部官员辞职以示抗议。

sentences.en: A new investigator was appointed, and the U.S. Supreme Court ordered Nixon to release the tapes.
sentences.zh: 一名新的调查员被任命，美国最高法院下令尼克松公布这些录音带。

sentences.en: At the same time, the House of Representatives voted to remove Nixon from office.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，众议院投票决定将尼克松免职。

sentences.en: They charged him with obstructing justice, abusing his power, covering up a crime, and violating the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 他们以妨碍司法公正、滥用职权、包庇犯罪以及违反宪法等罪名指控他。

sentences.en: Finally, Nixon released the tapes.
sentences.zh: 最终，尼克松公布了这些录音带。

sentences.en: But before the Senate could hold a trial – in which the president would almost certainly be found guilty – Richard Nixon resigned.
sentences.zh: 但在参议院举行审判之前——在那场审判中总统几乎肯定会被判有罪——理查德·尼克松辞职了。

sentences.en: He left the White House the following day.
sentences.zh: 他于次日离开了白宫。

sentences.en: Nixon lived for 20 more years.
sentences.zh: 尼克松又活了20年。

sentences.en: He wrote a number of books, traveled, spent time with his family, and offered foreign policy advice to other leaders.
sentences.zh: 他写了好几本书,四处游历,与家人共度时光,并其他领导人提供外交政策建议。

sentences.en: He continued to deny that he had done anything criminal as president; instead, Nixon said he had made bad decisions.
sentences.zh: 他继续否认自己在总统任内有犯罪行为;相反,尼克松说自己做出了错误的决定。

sentences.en: And he did not go to trial.
sentences.zh: 他也因此没有受审。

sentences.en: The next president, Gerald Ford, used his power to pardon Nixon “for all offenses against the United States.”
sentences.zh: 下一任总统杰拉尔德·福特动用其权力,赦免了尼克松"对美国所犯的一切罪行"。

sentences.en: But Nixon’s image was permanently damaged.
sentences.zh: 但尼克松的形象遭到了永久性的损害。

sentences.en: Most people found evidence in the tapes that Nixon knew about a related series of crimes commonly known as “Watergate.”
sentences.zh: 大多数人从录音带中找到了证据,证明尼克松知晓一桩通常被称为"水门事件"的相关系列犯罪。

sentences.en: They also found that some of his public statements were dishonest.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现,他的一些公开声明是不诚实的。

sentences.en: They said he made them to forward his own political goals, not to further the public good.
sentences.zh: 他们说,他发表这些声明是为了推进自己的政治目标,而非为了公共福祉。

sentences.en: As a result, Nixon’s place in U.S. history is generally thought to be a troubled one.
sentences.zh: 因此,尼克松在美国历史中的地位通常被认为是一段充满争议的岁月。

sentences.en: To be sure, he made a number of positive accomplishments, both within the U.S. and internationally.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问,他在美国国内和国际上都取得了诸多积极的成就。

sentences.en: But his presidency left the country shaken.
sentences.zh: 但他的总统任期让国家动荡不安。

sentences.en: When Ford replaced him as president, he said to Americans, “Our long national nightmare is over.”
sentences.zh: 当福特接替他就任总统时,他对美国人说道:"我们漫长的国家噩梦终于结束了。"

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。
